description: This file defines a utility object 'StringUtils' with functions to join a linked list into a string and split a string into a linked list, utilizing external utility objects 'JoinUtils' and 'SplitUtils'.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string manipulation utilities using linked lists.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList into a String by joining its elements.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList of strings.
